`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
if (WIDTH == 128 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 7 && W == 128) begin : fast_msb128
    wire [15:0] group_valid;
    wire [15:0] group_enable;
    wire [15:0] group_winner;
    wire [7:0] local_winner [0:15];
    wire [15:0] code_terms [0:6];
    genvar g, j, b;

    for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
        assign group_valid[g] = |input_unencoded[g*8 +: 8];
        if (g == 15) begin : top_group
            assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
        end else begin : lower_group
            assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
        end
        assign group_winner[g] = group_enable[g] & group_valid[g];

        for (j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin : local_priority
            if (j == 7) begin : top_bit
                assign local_winner[g][j] = input_unencoded[g*8+j];
            end else begin : lower_bit
                assign local_winner[g][j] = input_unencoded[g*8+j] &
                    ~(|input_unencoded[g*8+7:g*8+j+1]);
            end
            if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : zero_default
                assign output_unencoded[g*8+j] = group_enable[g] &
                    ~(|input_unencoded[7:1]);
            end else begin : ordinary_output
                assign output_unencoded[g*8+j] = group_enable[g] & local_winner[g][j];
            end
        end

        assign code_terms[0][g] = group_enable[g] &
            (local_winner[g][1] | local_winner[g][3] |
             local_winner[g][5] | local_winner[g][7]);
        assign code_terms[1][g] = group_enable[g] &
            ((|input_unencoded[g*8+7:g*8+6]) |
             ((~(|input_unencoded[g*8+7:g*8+4])) &
               (|input_unencoded[g*8+3:g*8+2])));
        assign code_terms[2][g] = group_enable[g] &
            (|input_unencoded[g*8+7:g*8+4]);
        for (b = 3; b < 7; b = b + 1) begin : upper_code_terms
            if ((g & (1 << (b-3))) != 0) begin : set_index_bit
                assign code_terms[b][g] = group_winner[g];
            end else begin : clear_index_bit
                assign code_terms[b][g] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end
    for (b = 0; b < 7; b = b + 1) begin : encode
        assign output_encoded[b] = |code_terms[b];
    end
    assign output_valid = |group_valid;
end else begin : reference_parameters
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
    genvar l, n;
    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_priority_selection
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin : high_priority_selection
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end
    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_priority_selection
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin : high_priority_selection
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
            end
        end
    end
    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
end
endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The reference feeds a seven-level priority-selection tree into a binary-to-one-hot decode. Consequently, output_unencoded depends on completing the encoded-index selection before decoding it, while low encoded bits traverse multiple selection stages.",
  "rewrite": "For the specified configuration, use sixteen eight-bit groups with parallel local priority masks and higher-group exclusion reductions. Generate one-hot outputs directly from local winners and group enables. Form encoded outputs with parallel masked reductions instead of decoding and re-encoding a serial selection chain. Retain the original implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival by removing the encoded-index-to-one-hot decode from the one-hot paths and replacing serial selection with parallel reductions. No numerical gain is claimed without running the specified SKY130HD mapping and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds parallel exclusion logic and reduction wiring, with shared group-valid and group-enable signals. Area, buffering, fanout, and electrical compliance require measurement in the fixed evaluation flow; the 4694.627520 um2 cap has not been independently verified.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Purely combinational, with unchanged module interface and parameter declarations. For WIDTH=128 and MSB priority, the highest asserted input determines both encoded and one-hot outputs. An all-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=128'b1, matching the reference rather than suppressing the default one-hot bit. Other parameter configurations retain the original equations, including padding, truncation, and LSB-priority defaults. No state, assumptions, undefined outputs, or additional latency are introduced."
}
